locationCode.description: "Location Code" where the Daily Prep transaction is created

description.description: "Description" is entered by the user when the transaction was created. If none was entered, this will be the Daily Prep Date.

status.description: "Status" of the Daily Prep transaction. Possible values: Completed, Incomplete, or Canceled

createDate.description: "Create Date" is a date the transaction was created

createUser.description: "Create User" is the user ID of the user who created the transaction

completeDate.description: "Complete Date" is a date with time the transaction was finalized

completeUser.description: "Complete User" is the user ID of the user who finalized the transaction

cancelDate.description: "Cancel Date" is a date with time the transaction was canceled

cancelUser.description: "Cancel User" is the user ID of the user who canceled the transaction

dailyPrepDate.description: "Daily Prep Date" is the date and time when the Daily Prep was performed, as selected by the user during creation

templateName.description: "Template Name" is the name of the Daily Prep template used for the transaction

templateLocationCode.description: "Template Location Code" is the location code associated with the Daily Prep template

cateringOrder.description: "Catering Order" indicates whether the prep transaction included Catering customer orders

dailyPrepApp.description: "Daily Prep App" is the application or process that created the Daily Prep transaction

prepLocation.description: "Prep Location" is the name of the Prep Customer selected for the Daily Prep transaction

productNumber.description: "Product Number" from Daily Prep Screen's Components Tab

name.description: "Product Name" from Daily Prep Screen's Components Tab

majorIngredient.description: "Major Ingredient" indicates whether the product is marked as a major ingredient in the recipe

quantity.description: "Quantity" is the amount of the product required for the recipe

invUnit.description: "Inv. Unit" is the inventory unit of measure used for the product

storageLocation.description: "Storage Location" is the location where the product is stored

unitPrice.description: "Unit Price" is the cost per inventory unit of the product

extendedValue.description: "Extended Value" is the total cost calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price

DailyPrepComponentDto.title: DailyPrepComponentDto
DailyPrepComponentDto.description: Component details for a Daily Prep recipe

productNumber.description: "Product Number" from Daily Prep Screen's Recipes Tab

name.description: "Recipe Name" from the Daily Prep screen's Recipes tab

batchQty.description: "Batch Qty" is the quantity produced in a single batch

batchUnit.description: "Batch Unit" is the unit of measure for the batch quantity

projectedConsumption.description: "Projected Consumption" is the amount expected to be used during the day

actualProd.description: "Actual Prod" is the actual quantity prepared

actualBatchCost.description: "Actual Batch Cost" is the calculated cost of producing one batch

storageLocation.description: "Storage Location" is the location where the prepared item is stored

prepStation.description: "Prep Station" is the kitchen station where the recipe is prepared

DailyPrepRecipeDto.title: DailyPrepRecipeDto
DailyPrepRecipeDto.description: Recipe details for a Daily Prep transaction
